name: Hunter Missile (Combat)
body:
You overwhelm your target with a quick move.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Improved Unarmed Strike, Rising Hunter Style, Fly 5 ranks

Benefits: While using this style and successfully attacking a target at a lower elevation than your own with an unarmed strike, reduce their maneuverability by one step and any vertical movement they make with their first move action during their next turn is halved. If you make a charge attack from a position at least 10 feet above a creature, you deal double damage with that attack if you use an unarmed strike.

Special: This feat’s benefits apply to light weapons, ranged weapons, and natural weapons.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
